intro: Overlord Mok'Morokk scoffs at your challenge, promises to crush you and invites you to say when you are ready to be thrashed. Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village had hoped to see Mok'Morokk driven out of the village.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You tell me when ready for good beating.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I thought you were going to attempt to drive Mok'Morokk out of the village. Instead you have come to me to chat?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That cowardly fat mass Mok'Morokk fled like a scared child. You have done a great service, friend.
Now my people can appoint a new leader, one who will help us reclaim our old home once and for all.
